seo.title: Plumber in Tampa Bay, FL | Easy Plumbing FL
seo.description: Licensed, insured Tampa Bay plumbers for leaks, clogs, water heaters, slab leaks and repipes. Upfront flat-rate pricing, same-day service and 24/7 emergency help.

hero.lead: Leaks, clogs, water heaters and full repipes, fixed right the first time by licensed local plumbers. You get a flat price before any work starts, and we leave your home cleaner than we found it.

trust.title: Upfront pricing
trust.text: A flat quote before work starts.

trust.title: Same-day service
trust.text: Most jobs done the day you call.

trust.title: 1-year warranty
trust.text: On every repair, parts and labor.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.description: Hidden leaks pinpointed with acoustic and thermal tools, then repaired without tearing your home apart.

services.title: Slab Leak Repair
services.description: Most Florida homes sit on a concrete slab. We locate slab leaks precisely and reroute or repair with minimal mess.

services.title: Drain Cleaning
services.description: Slow sinks, backed-up tubs and main-line clogs cleared with professional snaking and hydro-jetting.

services.title: Water Heaters
services.description: Tank and tankless water heaters repaired, flushed and replaced. Most installs are finished the same day.

services.title: Repiping
services.description: Whole-home repipes in PEX or copper to replace aging polybutylene, galvanized and cast-iron lines.

services.title: Sewer Line Service
services.description: Camera inspections, root removal and trenchless sewer repairs that keep your yard in one piece.

services.title: Softeners & Filtration
services.description: Florida's hard water is tough on fixtures and skin. Softeners, RO systems and whole-home filtration.

services.title: Fixtures & Toilets
services.description: Faucets, toilets, garbage disposals and shower valves installed or repaired, neatly and fast.

emergency.title: Burst pipe? Water where it shouldn't be?
emergency.text: Shut off your main water valve and call us. A licensed plumber can be on the way within the hour, day or night, weekends and holidays included.

about.lead: Easy Plumbing FL started with a simple promise: show up on time, explain the problem in plain English and charge exactly what we quoted. Every job still works that way.

reviews.quote: Our water bill doubled and two other companies couldn't find why. Easy Plumbing found a slab leak in an hour, rerouted the line the same day and quoted exactly what we paid.
reviews.name: Maria R.

reviews.quote: Water heater died on a Sunday morning. I called at 8, a plumber was here by 10 and we had hot water before lunch. Clean, friendly and no weekend upcharge games.

reviews.quote: We repiped our 1978 home with them. The crew protected every floor, patched the drywall and finished a day early. You'd never know they were here.

faq.question: How much do you charge?
faq.answer: Every job gets a flat, upfront price after your plumber diagnoses the problem, before any work starts. The price we quote is the price you pay, even if the job takes longer than expected.

faq.question: Do you really offer 24/7 emergency service?
faq.answer: Yes. Nights, weekends and holidays, a real person answers and a licensed plumber is dispatched, usually within the hour.

faq.question: Are your plumbers licensed and insured?
faq.answer: Every plumber on our team is state-licensed, fully insured and background-checked. We're happy to share proof of coverage before we start.

faq.question: How quickly can you get here?
faq.answer: Most calls get a same-day appointment with a two-hour arrival window. We text you when your plumber is on the way.

faq.question: Do you guarantee your work?
faq.answer: All repairs come with a 1-year parts and labor warranty. New water heaters and repipes are also covered by the manufacturer's warranty.
